values.note: Forest Service banner: 'Chapman Campground and Lake close Sept 8, 2026 for repair and improvements'. No reopening date posted; recreation.gov shows no availability after Sept 7, 2026, though its rate table still lists a 2027 season.

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/chapman-campground-and-group-campground (Current Conditions: 'Chapman Campground and Lake close Sept 8, 2026 for repair and improvements'; last updated September 2, 2026) + recreation.gov availability for 232159 (September 2026 nights end at 09-07), read 2026-10-26

values.note: $30 per family site (standard, RV and tent) in 2026 and 2027; the group site $260. Day use $9 per vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232159/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD/RV/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 30, GROUP 260) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/chapman-campground-and-group-campground ('Day Use Fee $9/day per vehicle'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/chapman-campground-and-group-campground ('Electrical hook-ups are not available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232159 ('RV's and campers cannot hook up to water via the spigots') + campsite catalog (all NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: The Forest Service says 84 standard sites plus a group site; the recreation.gov catalog lists 75 reservable family sites (8 of them tent-only) besides 8 management sites and the group site. Max vehicle lengths 25-55 ft, with six pull-throughs; five sites list 99 ft, a placeholder.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/chapman-campground-and-group-campground ('Chapman Campground has 84 standard sites suitable for tents, trailers, and RVs. One group site is also available.') + campsite catalog for 232159 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water in loops F, G and H, for filling jugs only. A September 2026 alert says the Ruedi Reservoir campgrounds have no well water.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232159 ('vault toilets, and drinking water located in Loops F, G & H'; 'the spigot is for self-fill jugs only') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/chapman-campground-and-group-campground ('vault toilets, and drinking water') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/alerts/no-water-campers-ruedi-reservoir-campgrounds-little-maud-and-mollie-b-closed, read 2026-10-26

values.note: Every family site is reservable on recreation.gov; the 2026 fee season ran May 13 - Oct 1 (cut short by the Sept 8 closure). Booking closes 2 days before arrival. No minimum stay (recreation.gov's minimums are 0). 14 nights at most, and 14 per month. Campers must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232159 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month', minWeekendStay 0 soft, minHolidayWeekendStay 0 soft, reservationCutOff 2; notice 'Campers must occupy the site the first night') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-13 to 10-01) + campsite catalog (every family site reservable), read 2026-10-26

note: Fryingpan Road 29 miles above Basalt, above Ruedi Reservoir (Aspen-Sopris RD, White River NF); a wide valley of lodgepole pine on the Fryingpan River, several sites at the river's edge, beside small Chapman Reservoir (no motorboats). Concession-run (American Land & Leisure). --Claude
summary: Recorded the Forest Service closure banner (closed from Sept 8, 2026 for repair and improvements, no reopening date) as temporarily_closed. Confirmed $30 (2026-27), no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed count 76 -> 75 (catalog family sites; FS says 84) and max_rig_ft 99 -> 55 (99 is a placeholder on five sites). Added pull-throughs, vault toilets, jug-fill water, 2-day cutoff, 14-night limit, reservable season 05-13 to 10-01.
flags: Temporary closure: the Forest Service page says 'Chapman Campground and Lake close Sept 8, 2026 for repair and improvements' with no reopening date; recreation.gov has no nights after Sept 7, 2026 but keeps a 2027 rate season. Re-check status before next summer.
